captions.text: Six-fifteen, the platform's grey,
I save a seat the same old way,
You step on at the second stop,
And all the city noise just drops.
We never say a single word,
But something on the glass is heard...
Seat number twenty-one,
You draw the rain, I draw the sun,
A hundred mornings, not one line,
Just your little heart beside mine,
Stations rushing, I don't mind,
Seat number twenty-one.
I learned your coffee, learned your sighs,
The way you count the passing skies,
Then I saw the letter in your hand,
A brand-new city, all you'd planned.
How do you say goodbye to someone
you never said hello to...
Seat number twenty-one,
You draw the rain, I draw the sun,
A hundred mornings, not one line,
Just your little heart beside mine,
Stations rushing, I don't mind,
Seat number twenty-one.
Last ride, your seat is cold,
The window's bare, the story's told,
I wave at fog and walk away,
A longer train, a longer day...
Seat number twenty... one?
Your hand's the one that draws the sun,
You booked the seat right next to mine,
Guess we're finally on the same line.
Every station, every mile,
Seat number twenty-one.
